fixture/receipts.notes.md:
# Printed receipts

## Desired outcome

Printed receipts include the settled return line, then a barcode, and a renamed total label.

## Decisions

- D1: Receipt text is built in src/receipt.mjs only.
- D2: The return copy is "Returns within 14 days with receipt."
- D3: The barcode work merges only after the return-line ticket.
- D4: Renaming the total label shares src/receipt.mjs and has no merge order of its own.

## Non-goals

- Email receipts.
- A PDF renderer.

fixture/receipts.tech-design/return-line.md:
# Return line

## Behavior

renderReceipt appends the exact line "Returns within 14 days with receipt." after the total line.

## Affected code

- src/receipt.mjs — the function returns the item line and `Total:` line today.
- src/receipt.test.mjs — the test named "includes the total" must keep passing.

## Verification

`node --test src/receipt.test.mjs` from the delivery repo.

# Barcode

## Behavior

After the return line is in the receipt, renderReceipt appends a barcode line. This ticket merges only after T2.

## Affected code

- src/receipt.mjs — same file as the return line. There is no barcode file in the repo.
fixture/receipts.tech-design/total-label.md:
# Total label

## Behavior

The total line label changes from `Total:` to `Amount due:`. It does not wait on the return line or the barcode.

## Affected code

- src/receipt.mjs — same file, no required merge order.
- src/receipt.test.mjs — "includes the total" currently expects `Total:`.
fixture/receipts.tickets/T2.md:
---
title: "Return line"
ticket: T2
epic: receipts
---

## Goal

renderReceipt appends the exact line "Returns within 14 days with receipt." after the total line.

## Scope

In src/receipt.mjs, keep the item line and the Total: line, then append that return line. Leave src/receipt.test.mjs able to pass the existing test named "includes the total". Do not add a barcode and do not rename the total label.

## Acceptance criteria

renderReceipt returns the item line, then a line that still begins with Total:, then the exact line Returns within 14 days with receipt. The test named "includes the total" still passes. From the delivery repo, node --test src/receipt.test.mjs passes.

## Files

src/receipt.mjs,src/receipt.test.mjs

fixture/receipts.tickets/T5.md:
---
title: "Total label"
ticket: T5
epic: receipts
---

## Goal

The total line label changes from Total: to Amount due:.

## Scope

In src/receipt.mjs, rename the total line label from Total: to Amount due:. In src/receipt.test.mjs, the test named "includes the total" currently expects Total: and must expect Amount due: instead. This ticket does not wait on the return line or the barcode.

## Acceptance criteria

renderReceipt prints Amount due: where it printed Total:. The test named "includes the total" expects Amount due:. The ticket has no merge dependency on T2 or T4. From the delivery repo, node --test src/receipt.test.mjs passes.

## Files

src/receipt.mjs,src/receipt.test.mjs
